result_summary: Root cause: worker-mutex.h:65 expects a same-thread owner re-wait through a second handle to grant (WAIT_OBJECT_0), but mb_win_mutex.c:368-385 (adapter policy) never re-grants an owner re-wait and returns WAIT_TIMEOUT 258, so mb_worker_mutex_prepare fails with -68 BEFORE CreateThread; WorkerBegin's failure handler calls mb_worker_mutex_finish which (pre-MFR-2) returns -72 at its first check, before the retirement loop, leaking the 5 kept tokens; mb_win_mutex_close then BUSYs forever and sdk_driver's cleanup retry loop hangs (phases stop at 4=CLEANUP_PENDING; watchdog kill). windows_error 2 comes from that same failure-path finish(): OpenMutexW on the not-yet-existing abandon name -> ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND.
deliverables: worker-mutex.h.diff (fix 1: reorder named-mutex checks so owner re-wait is only tested as WAIT_TIMEOUT and the second handle grants after release; fix 2: MFR-2 all-exit retirement in finish)
worker-fixture.c.diff (MFR-2: retire kept tokens on every failure exit; bounded worker drain in fixture_fail; finishes on -2/-16/-17/-18 paths; all codes unchanged)
